root_cause_verification.rationale: The per-request MCP transport fix IS present in the worktree dist (confirmed: handleMcpRequest and createMcpServer patterns found in index-LvSIZVJE.mjs). The dev daemon (pid 3912410) IS running from the worktree dist. HOWEVER, the existing CLI session processes (pid 2025542, 2025675) were spawned by the OLD daemon BEFORE it was restarted, and they run from /usr/lib/node_modules/happy-coder/dist/index.mjs (old code). The MCP HTTP server runs INSIDE each CLI session process, not inside the daemon. Therefore, the running sessions still have the old broken 'reuse transport' code. The fix exists in code but is not deployed to the running sessions.

all_findings.issue: Existing CLI sessions running old pre-fix code. The MCP server runs inside each CLI session process. The daemon was restarted with the fix, but the already-running sessions were not killed/respawned. They continue using old code from /usr/lib/node_modules/happy-coder/dist/index.mjs which has the broken 'reuse transport' pattern.
all_findings.recommendation: Kill the old CLI session processes and let the new daemon respawn them. The new daemon (pid 3912410) runs from the worktree dist which has the per-request MCP transport fix. New sessions spawned by this daemon will use the fixed code. Alternatively: restart the sessions via 'curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:46407/spawn-session' for each session UUID.
